sentences.text:
==
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Ajay Kumar Jha, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Sharma, App

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajiv Roy
 Oral Order

The petitioner is in custody in connection with Special Excise Case No. 182 of 2023 arising out of Rani Talab P.S. Case No. 23 of 2023 for the offence under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 30(a), 32(ii), (iii), 36, 41(i)(ii) of Bihar Prohibition and Excise Act, 2018 lodged on 23.01.2023 by the informant, Vimlesh Kumar Paswan.
As per the prosecution story, the Police intercepted a mini Truck and recovered/seized 625.425 liters of foreign made liquor and arrested the driver, Yashwant Kumar.
It is the further case of prosecution that even the engine number and chassis number of the truck was tampered.
Accordingly, the F.I.R. Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.41267 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that his name has come in the confessional statement of the driver.

He neither owns the truck nor is the driver, one of the accused Yashwant Kumar has since been granted bail vide Cr. Misc. No. 33578 of 2023 by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court and further he do not have any criminal antecedent.
Learned APP opposes the prayer stating that the recovery is of 625.425 liters of foreign liquor.

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the alleged recovery is from Yashwant Kumar, the petitioner name has come in the confessional statement, he do not have any criminal antecedent, is in custody since 01.04.2023 and further Yashwant Kumar has since been granted bail, this Court is inclined to extend him the privilege of bail with conditions.
With the aforesaid observations, the bail application is allowed.

(Rajiv Roy, J) kiran/-
